items.title: Yelp Combines Native and Server-Driven UI for Its AI Assistant
items.summaryShort: Yelp Combines Native and Server-Driven UI for Its AI Assistant. Yelp combines native mobile controls with server-driven conversation rendering in its AI Assistant using the CHAOS framework.

items.title: TypeScript 7.1 Beta: Restores the Compiler API and Makes Vue and Svelte First-Class
items.summaryShort: TypeScript 7.1 Beta: Restores the Compiler API and Makes Vue and Svelte First-Class. TypeScript 7.1 Beta, announced October 20, 2026, restores the compiler API removed in 7.0, now split into separate entry points.

items.title: Presentation: The Socio-Technical Staff+ Engineer: Architecture, Culture and Organisational Change
items.summaryShort: Presentation: The Socio-Technical Staff+ Engineer: Architecture, Culture and Organisational Change. Vanessa Formicola shares how technical leaders can move beyond "wishful architecture" by practicing holistic socio-technical engineering.

items.title: AWS Ships Continuum for Code Vulnerabilities
items.summaryShort: AWS Ships Continuum for Code Vulnerabilities. AWS has made Continuum for code vulnerabilities generally available in two regions.

items.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
items.summaryShort: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era. Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.
